xiao.mounting_method: through-hole: insert both factory-installed 1x7 straight male header rows through U1, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim excess pin length
xiao.orientation: component side up; USB-C points toward +Y/top edge; factory-installed straight male header rows pass through the motherboard

xiao_assembly: Insert both factory-installed 1x7 male header rows through U1, hold the XIAO component-side up with USB-C toward the USB arrow, solder from the motherboard underside, inspect, then trim excess pin length.
